subtitle: Lesson 36 — 自行车被人骑走了 · The bike was ridden away by someone

items.en: The bike was ridden away by someone.

items.py: Wǒ de bēizi bèi tā dǎ suì le.
items.en: My cup was broken by him.

items.py: Nà běn shū bèi tā jiè zǒu le.
items.en: That book was borrowed by him.

items.py: Xìn bèi fēng chuī zǒu le.
items.en: The letter was blown away by the wind.

items.py: Dàngāo bèi háizimen chī wán le.
items.en: The cake was eaten up by the children.

items.zh: 大卫：我的自行车不见了！
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ de zìxíngchē bú jiàn le!
Liú Jīng: Nǐ fàng zài nǎr le?
items.en: Liu Jing: Where did you put it?

items.zh: 大卫：就放在楼下。可能被人骑走了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Jiù fàng zài lóu xià. Kěnéng bèi rén qí zǒu le.
items.en: David: Right downstairs. Maybe someone rode it away.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ suǒ le méiyǒu?
items.en: Liu Jing: Did you lock it?

items.py: Dàwèi: Méiyǒu. Wǒ wàng le suǒ.
items.en: David: No. I forgot to lock it.

items.zh: 刘京：以后一定要锁好车。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Yǐhòu yīdìng yào suǒ hǎo chē.
items.en: Liu Jing: You must lock the bike from now on.

items.zh: 玛丽：你怎么了？手怎么了？
items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ zěnme le? Shǒu zěnme le?
items.en: Mary: What happened? What's wrong with your hand?

items.py: Hézǐ: Bèi mén jiā le yīxià.
items.en: Hezi: It got caught in the door.

items.py: Mǎlì: Téng bu téng?

items.zh: 和子：有点儿疼。没关系，不严重。
items.py: Hézǐ: Yǒudiǎnr téng. Méi guānxi, bù yánzhòng.
items.en: Hezi: A little. It's OK, not serious.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ de zuòyè ne?

items.zh: 和子：被我弄湿了。我重新写吧。
items.py: Hézǐ: Bèi wǒ nòng shī le. Wǒ chóngxīn xiě ba.
items.en: Hezi: I got it wet. I'll rewrite it.

items.py: Zìxíngchē bèi rén qí zǒu le.
items.en: 被 + agent + verb + result: bike was ridden away

items.py: Bēizi bèi tā dǎ suì le.
items.en: The cup was broken by him.

items.py: Shū bèi jiè zǒu le.
Yīfu bèi yǔ lín shī le.
items.en: The clothes got wet from the rain.

items.py: Qián bèi tā huā wán le.
items.en: The money was spent by him.

items.zh: 书被借走了。→ 钱被花完了。
items.py: Shū bèi jiè zǒu le. → Qián bèi huā wán le.
items.en: Book was borrowed. → Money was spent.

items.py: Dàngāo bèi chī wán le.
Chuānghu bèi fēng chuī kāi le.
items.en: The window was blown open by the wind.

items.py: Tā de shǒujī bèi tōu le.
Mén bèi guān shang le.
